name: PhilSys National ID (Polycarbonate Card)
description: Philippine Identification (PhilID) polycarbonate physical card issued by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) under RA 11055.

fields.name: Headings and National Emblems
fields.description: Republika ng Pilipinas header, PhilSys logo, and National Emblem banner.

fields.name: Cardholder Face Photo
fields.description: Primary portrait photograph of the cardholder on the front-left section.

fields.name: PhilSys Card Number (PCN)
fields.description: 16-digit card-specific identifier (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) printed above demographic data.

fields.name: Full Name
fields.description: Last Name (Apelyido), Given Names (Mga Pangalan), and Middle Name (Gitnang Apelyido).

fields.name: Signature / Ghost Image
fields.description: Secondary security marking / ghost image / signature zone.
